warnings: This drawing set prints NO grid bubbles anywhere (structural or architectural) — only dimension chains. Labels were assigned here: numbers 1-12 on the 12 column lines along x (11 bays × 3.50 = 38.50, left to right as drawn on the S-plans), letters A-D on the column rows along y (A top = the side the toilet blocks project from, B +4.00, C +7.00, D +9.20 = the stair-wing footings). Origin A1 (top-left).

Scanned set, sheets drawn rotated 90° on portrait paper; read rotated. Hand lettering: the 3rd x bay on แปลนฐานรากคานคอดิน and the 8th on แปลนคานหลังคา read like '3.60', but every other chain prints 3.50 and all four totals print 38.50 = 11 × 3.50 — taken as 3.50, printed_as kept.

Beam B1 (the partition beam inside each toilet block) and beam B12 (the block's inner wall) are drawn on the F2/F3 beam plans but not dimensioned there. Their lines come from the architectural sheet 2: the toilet plan prints the ห้องส้วมครู partition 1.50 right of grid 2 (2' = 5.00) and the cross section through the stair/toilet bay prints 0.80 + 1.20 (A'' = 0.80 below row A). Scaling the S-plans gives ≈1.3 and ≈0.55-0.70 — hand-drawn plans are not to scale in that tight corner; the printed values were taken (structural sheets print nothing to contradict them).

The right toilet block's B1 (10' = 33.50) is printed on no sheet; the toilet plan is drawn for the left block only. 33.50 = x11 − 1.50 (mirror of the printed left value) and agrees with the scaled 2.0-2.1 from grid 10 on both beam plans; flagged.

The S6 cantilever slab along row C (outside the stair wings) and the roof eave below row C are drawn but not dimensioned on any swept sheet, so no line was made for their outer edges; the roof eave on the A side coincides with A' (1.20).

z_levels come from the cross section (รูปตัดตามขวาง, sheet 2). ชานพักชั้น 3 is labelled there but its height is not dimensioned (the 3.15 row spans พื้นชั้น 2 → พื้นชั้น 3 in one segment), so it has no z_levels entry. Both upper floors are also labelled ระดับพื้นห้องนอน on the right; the left labels พื้นชั้น 2 / พื้นชั้น 3 were used as ids.

Dimension sweep (op04 pass2-only): every chain on the structural sheets 5-7 (sheet 7 prints only member-internal dimensions — section sizes, bar cut-offs, slab spans — which stay on the elements), plus the cross section and the 1.50 partition chain of the toilet plan on sheet 2. NOT swept: sheet 1 floor plans/elevations (they reprint the same 3.50 / 4.00 / 3.00 / 2.20 / 1.80 chains), the remaining fixture dimensions of the sheet-2 toilet plan (1.20 stall, 0.20 / 0.60 counter, 0.45 shaft), sheets 3, 4, 8 and the furniture sheets 9-11.
